name: AP service autostart
purpose: Verify Jetson AP starts automatically after full robot boot.
procedure: Power-cycle robot. Do not SSH/start service manually. Scan SSID. On Jetson check: systemctl --failed; nmcli connection show --active; systemctl status NetworkManager.
expected: Jetson SSID becomes visible/connectable automatically; no failed AP/network service.
evidence_plan: Boot timestamp, SSID scan, active connection, service status

source_fields.Expected Result: Jetson SSID becomes visible/connectable automatically; no failed AP/network service.
source_fields.Evidence to Capture: Boot timestamp, SSID scan, active connection, service status

name: Wi-Fi interface state
purpose: Verify wireless interface is UP, managed and bound to AP profile.
procedure: ip -br link; ip -br addr; nmcli device status; nmcli connection show --active
expected: Expected interface is UP/connected and has configured AP address.

source_fields.Objective: Verify wireless interface is UP, managed and bound to AP profile.

name: SSID/BSSID identity
procedure: Laptop: nmcli device wifi rescan; nmcli -f SSID,BSSID,CHAN,FREQ,SIGNAL,SECURITY dev wifi list. Repeat 3 scans.
expected: Expected SSID appears with valid stable BSSID.

source_fields.Procedure / Commands: Laptop: nmcli device wifi rescan; nmcli -f SSID,BSSID,CHAN,FREQ,SIGNAL,SECURITY dev wifi list. Repeat 3 scans.

procedure: Scan from laptop; inspect nmcli connection show <AP_PROFILE>.
expected: Band/channel/security match design; AP is not accidentally open.

source_fields.Expected Result: Band/channel/security match design; AP is not accidentally open.

procedure: Forget old profile, connect to Jetson SSID, inspect active connection.
expected: Authentication succeeds without loop or timeout.

procedure: Connect clean client; ip addr; ip route; resolvectl status.

name: Lease renew/reconnect
procedure: Record IP; disconnect 30 s; reconnect; inspect IP/route; repeat 5 cycles.
expected: 5/5 reconnect; no duplicate IP, stale route or DHCP timeout.

expected: Required services reachable; unintended ports not exposed.

purpose: Verify AP recovers after controlled network restart.

expected: SSID, DHCP and services recover without Jetson reboot.

name: Network error log inspection
procedure: journalctl -b | grep -Ei 'wlan|wifi|NetworkManager|hostapd|dnsmasq|dhcp|firmware|deauth|disconnect|fail|error'
expected: No recurring firmware reset, deauth storm or DHCP failure.

name: 2-hour Jetson AP endurance
purpose: Verify AP stability for a full operating cycle.
preconditions: Client connected; robot under normal load.
procedure: Continuous ping/service check 2 h. Every 10 min record RSSI, RTT, loss, interface state, CPU/temp.
expected: No AP disappearance, forced reconnect, service crash or threshold violation.
